data.title: 空门苍 · 壁橱里的闷热紧贴
data.description: 为了躲避巡查而挤进狭窄的壁橱内，两人的体温在逼仄的空间里急剧攀升。苍跨坐在膝头，衬衫完全湿透紧贴着饱满的胸脯，在近在咫尺的耳畔吐出温热的气息。
data.location: cramped cedar wood storage closet filled with folded spare blankets
data.action: 苍跨坐在膝头，衬衫完全湿透紧贴着饱满的胸脯，在近在咫尺的耳畔吐出温热的气息
data.lighting: dim amber light slicing through closet door slats illuminating glistening sweat droplets
data.promptProse: Crowded inside a narrow wooden closet to hide in the dim light, Ao sits astride her partner's lap with her face inches from his ear. Thin slats of light cross their faces as heat builds in the enclosed space.
data.animaCaption: Huddled inside the cramped dark closet, she straddles her partner's lap in a sweat-dampened pale blue shirt clinging sheerly to her chest, leaning close to his ear with flushed cheeks and parted lips.
data.nsfwProse: Her oversized pale-blue sleep shirt is damp with perspiration and unbuttoned down the front, clinging transparently to her curves while its hem rides up over her bare thighs.
